title: [VSC-23] VS Code task detail: refresh the Delivery section and Release Agent button live, and pin blocker labels to MoeBundle
description:
Filed by VSC-18 (task-43363b5d) from its adversarial pass over the epic diff.
1. The Delivery section (VSC-8) and the Release Agent button (VSC-11) are rendered only in the initial HTML (TaskDetailPanel.getWebviewContent). The live path, debouncedUpdate posting 'updateTask' to media/taskDetail.js (around line 336), rebuilds only the status badge, #blockerSection, the plan and the comments. So a candidate, check run or receipt recorded while the panel is open stays stale until it is reopened. A task assigned after the panel opened gets no Release Agent button, and a released one keeps a stale button (that click answers with the info message). JetBrains refreshes its delivery section on every state update (TaskDetailDialog.refreshDeliverySection). Fix idea from architect comment-97b50ba7 on VSC-18: the panel posts the precomputed deliveryRows and labels with 'updateTask', and taskDetail.js rebuilds an always-present #deliverySection from DOM text nodes, as renderBlocker does. Do the same for the button's visibility.
2. BLOCK_CAUSE_LABEL and BLOCK_CAUSE_CLEARS exist in 3 VS Code copies: TaskDetailPanel.ts, media/board.js and media/taskDetail.js. They equal moe.blocker.* in MoeBundle.properties today, but no test pins that: tests/blocker-corpus.test.cjs compares the chip with the panel's own constant. Add a bundle-equality assertion, as delivery-corpus does for moe.delivery.*.
definitionOfDone: With the panel open, an 'updateTask' carrying new delivery evidence re-renders #deliverySection, and one without delivery removes it. A node:test drives the real panel and the raw media/taskDetail.js in vm, every daemon string goes through text nodes or escapeHtml, and the test proves it.
The Release Agent button appears or disappears on a live 'updateTask' when assignedWorkerId changes, with a test.
A test asserts that the blocker cause and clearance labels in all 3 VS Code copies equal moe.blocker.* in MoeBundle.properties.
In a git-archive snapshot, moe-vscode `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0 and no existing test is weakened.
reopenReason: Governor promote under "keep the board moving" (10:52Z) and "go on the vscode epic". VSC-18 filed this from its adversarial pass. It is lane-free: no open row plans TaskDetailPanel.ts or media/taskDetail.js.
